description: Calculate the BaZi (Four Pillars) chart from a local birth date, time, IANA timezone, and decimal longitude. The calculation uses local apparent true solar time, astronomical solar-term boundaries, and the 23:00 Zi-hour next-day boundary. Returns only reproducible chart facts and provenance, not interpretation or prediction.

date.description: Local civil date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

latitude.description: Optional birth latitude in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

time.description: Local civil time in HH:mm format.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai or America/Los_Angeles.

name: calculate_four_pillars
